name: Starbound (Reliable Workshop)

description: Starbound dedicated server using Steam's canonical linux/ layout and boot-time reconciliation of downloaded Workshop packages.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

SERVER_ROOT=/mnt/server
STEAMCMD_ROOT="${SERVER_ROOT}/steamcmd"
APP_ID="${SRCDS_APPID:-211820}"

fail() {
  echo "[starbound-install] ERROR: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

[[ -n "${STEAM_USER:-}" ]] || fail "Steam User is required and cannot be anonymous"
[[ -n "${STEAM_PASS:-}" ]] || fail "Steam Password is required for a fresh installation"

mkdir -p "${STEAMCMD_ROOT}" "${SERVER_ROOT}/mods" "${SERVER_ROOT}/storage"
cd /tmp
curl --fail --location --silent --show-error \
  --output steamcmd.tar.gz \
  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C "${STEAMCMD_ROOT}"

export HOME="${SERVER_ROOT}"
STEAMCMD_LOG="${SERVER_ROOT}/steamcmd-install.log"
AUTH_MARKER="${SERVER_ROOT}/.steam-auth-required"

run_steamcmd() {
  local timeout_seconds="$1"
  local status
  local -a steam_command
  shift

  steam_command=("${STEAMCMD_ROOT}/steamcmd.sh" "$@")
  if (( timeout_seconds > 0 )); then
    steam_command=(timeout --signal=TERM "${timeout_seconds}" "${steam_command[@]}")
  fi

  : > "${STEAMCMD_LOG}"
  set +e
  "${steam_command[@]}" </dev/null 2>&1 | tee "${STEAMCMD_LOG}"
  status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  set -e
  return "${status}"
}

if [[ -z "${STEAM_AUTH:-}" ]]; then
  echo "[starbound-install] probing Steam login; an unrecognized machine may trigger an email code"
  if ! run_steamcmd 120 +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" +quit ||
    ! grep -Fq "Logged in OK" "${STEAMCMD_LOG}"; then
    touch "${AUTH_MARKER}"
    fail "Steam did not authorize this machine. If an email code arrived, stage 1 is complete: set Steam Auth to the newest five-character code and click Reinstall immediately. Installer variables cannot change mid-run. See steamcmd-install.log."
  fi
fi

steam_login=(+login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}")
if [[ -n "${STEAM_AUTH:-}" ]]; then
  steam_login+=("${STEAM_AUTH}")
fi

if ! run_steamcmd 0 \
  +force_install_dir "${SERVER_ROOT}" \
  "${steam_login[@]}" \
  +app_update "${APP_ID}" validate \
  +quit ||
  ! grep -Fq "Success! App '${APP_ID}' fully installed." "${STEAMCMD_LOG}"; then
  touch "${AUTH_MARKER}"
  if [[ -n "${STEAM_AUTH:-}" ]]; then
    fail "SteamCMD rejected the supplied code or failed the update. Use the newest email code and click Reinstall again; inspect steamcmd-install.log for the exact Steam error."
  fi
  fail "SteamCMD failed after login. Inspect steamcmd-install.log, then click Reinstall."
fi

[[ -x "${SERVER_ROOT}/linux/starbound_server" ]] || \
  fail "SteamCMD completed without installing linux/starbound_server"
[[ -f "${SERVER_ROOT}/assets/packed.pak" ]] || \
  fail "SteamCMD completed without installing assets/packed.pak"
rm -f -- "${AUTH_MARKER}"

install -D -m 0644 \
  "${STEAMCMD_ROOT}/linux32/steamclient.so" \
  "${SERVER_ROOT}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
install -D -m 0644 \
  "${STEAMCMD_ROOT}/linux64/steamclient.so" \
  "${SERVER_ROOT}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"

if [[ ! -s "${SERVER_ROOT}/storage/starbound_server.config" ]]; then
  curl --fail --location --silent --show-error \
    --output "${SERVER_ROOT}/storage/starbound_server.config" \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/starbound/starbound_server.config
fi

cat > "${SERVER_ROOT}/start-starbound.sh" <<'STARBOUND_LAUNCHER'
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

ROOT="${SERVER_ROOT:-/home/container}"
APP_ID="${SRCDS_APPID:-211820}"
MOD_DIR="${ROOT}/mods"
WORKSHOP_ROOT="${ROOT}/steamapps/workshop/content/${APP_ID}"
SERVER_BIN="${ROOT}/linux/starbound_server"
STAGING_DIR=""

fail() {
  echo "[starbound-launcher] ERROR: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

cleanup_staging() {
  if [[ -n "${STAGING_DIR}" && -d "${STAGING_DIR}" ]]; then
    rm -rf -- "${STAGING_DIR}"
  fi
}

remove_managed_links() {
  local candidate base

  for candidate in "${MOD_DIR}"/workshop_*.pak; do
    [[ -L "${candidate}" ]] || continue
    rm -f -- "${candidate}"
  done

  for candidate in "${MOD_DIR}"/*.pak; do
    [[ -L "${candidate}" ]] || continue
    base="${candidate##*/}"
    if [[ "${base}" =~ ^[0-9]+_[0-9]+\.pak$ ]]; then
      rm -f -- "${candidate}"
    fi
  done
}

[[ -x "${SERVER_BIN}" ]] || fail "missing executable ${SERVER_BIN}; reinstall with this egg"
mkdir -p "${MOD_DIR}"
shopt -s nullglob

case "${WORKSHOP:-1}" in
  1|true|TRUE|yes|YES|on|ON) workshop_enabled=1 ;;
  0|false|FALSE|no|NO|off|OFF) workshop_enabled=0 ;;
  *) fail "WORKSHOP must be a boolean value" ;;
esac

if (( workshop_enabled == 1 )); then
  [[ -d "${WORKSHOP_ROOT}" ]] || \
    fail "Workshop loading is enabled but ${WORKSHOP_ROOT} does not exist"

  STAGING_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${ROOT}/.workshop-links.XXXXXX")"
  trap cleanup_staging EXIT
  package_count=0
  item_count=0

  for item_dir in "${WORKSHOP_ROOT}"/*; do
    [[ -d "${item_dir}" ]] || continue
    item_id="${item_dir##*/}"
    if [[ ! "${item_id}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
      echo "[starbound-launcher] skipping unexpected Workshop directory: ${item_id}" >&2
      continue
    fi

    item_package_count=0
    package_index=0
    while IFS= read -r package; do
      package_path="${package#"${ROOT}/"}"
      link_name="workshop_${item_id}_${package_index}.pak"
      relative_target="../${package_path}"
      ln -s -- "${relative_target}" "${STAGING_DIR}/${link_name}"
      package_count=$((package_count + 1))
      item_package_count=$((item_package_count + 1))
      package_index=$((package_index + 1))
    done < <(find "${item_dir}" -type f -name '*.pak' -print | LC_ALL=C sort)

    if (( item_package_count > 0 )); then
      item_count=$((item_count + 1))
    fi
  done

  (( package_count > 0 )) || \
    fail "Workshop loading is enabled but no .pak files were found in ${WORKSHOP_ROOT}"

  new_links=("${STAGING_DIR}"/workshop_*.pak)
  for staged_link in "${new_links[@]}"; do
    link_name="${staged_link##*/}"
    destination="${MOD_DIR}/${link_name}"
    if [[ -e "${destination}" && ! -L "${destination}" ]]; then
      fail "reserved managed path ${destination} is occupied by a non-symlink; rename that manual package"
    fi
  done

  remove_managed_links
  mv -- "${new_links[@]}" "${MOD_DIR}/"
  trap - EXIT
  rmdir "${STAGING_DIR}"
  STAGING_DIR=""
  echo "[starbound-launcher] linked ${package_count} Workshop packages from ${item_count} items"
else
  remove_managed_links
  echo "[starbound-launcher] Workshop loading disabled; managed links removed"
fi

cd "${ROOT}/linux"
exec ./starbound_server
STARBOUND_LAUNCHER

chmod 0755 "${SERVER_ROOT}/start-starbound.sh"
echo "[starbound-install] installation complete; canonical server binary retained in linux/"

variables.name: Steam User
variables.description: Admin-only Steam account that owns Starbound and holds the desired Workshop subscriptions.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Admin-only password for the Steam account used to install Starbound.

variables.name: Game ID
variables.description: Steam application and Workshop ID for Starbound.

variables.name: Steam Auth
variables.description: Newest five-character Steam Guard code. For email Guard, install once with this blank to trigger the email, then set the code and click Reinstall immediately. Clear it after success.

variables.name: Auto Update Server
variables.description: Run SteamCMD before startup. Disabled by default to avoid delays and stale Steam Guard codes; enable temporarily to refresh the game and subscriptions.

variables.name: Load Downloaded Workshop Content
variables.description: Link downloaded subscribed Workshop packages into mods/ on every boot. Steam may download subscriptions regardless of this loading switch.
